sources.title: Schiphol and KLM strengthen joint approach to winter weather
sources.summary: The airport attributes early-January disruption to prolonged heavy snowfall together with operational response problems, including de-icing demand, handling delays and delayed capacity reductions.

sources.title: 2 January: Delays and cancellations due to winter weather
sources.summary: The airport's notice for January 2 warns of disruption from winter weather, wind and aircraft de-icing.
